name: Blue Potion of Dragon’s Breath

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: For 1 minute, a Magic action breathes a 15-ft Cone of Lightning (Dex DC 13, 3d6, half on a success).
text: When you drink this potion you gain the benefit of Dragon's Breath for 1 minute without needing Concentration: as a Magic action you exhale a 15-foot Cone, and each creature in it makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
